notes.title: Clash of Legions – "Rebirth of Legions" Reconstruction Now Live!
notes.notes:
Dear Expedition Commanders,

Thank you for your continued support and passion for [b]Clash of Legions[/b]. [b]To provide a better gaming experience, we have fully reconstructed the game and launched a brand-new version: Rebirth of Legions.[/b] With this reconstruction, the old version's data will not be carried over. However, we will provide generous migration compensation for all players. Please join our official Discord server for the latest updates and details:  

[b]Official Discord: https://discord.gg/K4aAP7G8nB[/b]

notes.title: Merge server repair instructions
notes.notes:
The merge server is being repaired. The account data may be missing when you enter the game, but don't worry. The data will return to normal after the merge server is completed. And send out service stop compensation.

Please do not recharge during repair to avoid loss.

The repair completion time shall be subject to the arrival of compensation.

notes.title: Server Merging Notification
notes.notes:
In order to bring you a high-quality game experience and meet more like-minded friends, we expect to stop serving at 22:30 on December 21, 2021(PST), which is expected to last about 4 hours. The following servers will be merged after the service suspension:

steam steam2 steam3

In order to avoid unnecessary losses during the service cooperation, please prepare for offline in advance. After the service is merged, the roles and data are normally retained. You can log in to different roles according to different service selection entrances. Thank you for your long-term understanding and support. Have a nice game!

4. Fix the disconnection problem in the login scene
5. Fix the problem that the new player guide is stuck
